note: Both sets capture the bulkhead build-up (GYP cladding, P3 finish), the 6" platform, the 3/4" MDF gable and the 1/2" MDF P3 finish, and both scatter the same 3'-0" dimension across several components. A adds the 2" x 6" framing and 8" base that B omits, but it repeats the 3/4" = 1'-0" scale four times, truncates an entity to "CENTER MO", and binds 3'-0"/6"/5" to the dining table and to DW with invented conditions. B is cleaner overall, keeps the 1" side clearance and the MWK04 2'-0" width, but invents "dimension B", misbinds 4'-0" to the DIRTT wall, and includes a trivial "GT" claim whose quote supports nothing.
remarks: The text layer is a jumbled, unordered dump of the dimension strings, so several dimension-to-object bindings (the 3'-0", 5", 6" and 4'-0" values) cannot be verified from the text alone and were judged only as far as the image supports them; both extractions guess at these. Both sets miss the laundry-section dimensions (2'-5 1/16", 6 1/2", 7'-0 1/8") and the island dimensions (6'-7 1/2", 3'-3 3/4", 2'-2 3/16"), and neither keeps the full clearance note (A takes the 12" above, B takes the 1" either side). Repeated scale claims (3/4" = 1'-0") and the same 3'-0" value restated under several component names are the main noise pattern in both sets.
